science.explanation: This project aims to develop an autogenerator logic for systems, leveraging the principles of Utah's 1st thought and incorporating domain-specific knowledge from SYSTEMS.
assumptions: The system can be accurately modeled using a set of equations.
The autogenerator logic will be able to learn from existing data and adapt to new situations.
